notes: Card identity, cost, printed damage, and visible effect text were transcribed from the supplied source.
Kyokoro outcome-orientation mapping and special-effect runtime encoding are intentionally deferred to the effect inventory / runtime pass.
Repeat-until-fail and weakness-ignore behavior require special runtime mapping.
Special card behavior is now explicitly represented in special_effects instead of being absent. Roll-sequence execution is intentionally pending.

10.7d: Electric Rush repeats the entire same Move after a successful Kyokoro result. Each repeated Move rolls Kyokoro again; a failed repeat Kyokoro still resolves that repeated Move and then stops the chain.
10.8a metadata cleanup: Electric Rush runtime is complete; the generic repeat_until_fail entry remains as inventory/reference metadata while repeat_same_move_until_fail is the executable semantic.
